provenance: Original ONSITE procedural geometry and original Pillow/numpy printed artwork; no external asset downloads. Fonts and artwork sources recorded in public/materials/heron/lived/manifest.json.
units: metres; authoring x east, y up, z south; glTF world x=mapX-72, y=mapY, z=mapZ-60
collision: None; additions fit existing walls, glazing, open leaf, shelf footprints and ground.

features.name: Recessed window trim and raised shutter housings
features.support: Existing north wall and window frames
features.notes: Both glazing bays retain their open views. Door housing starts above the 2.4 m portal.

features.name: Shop window notices
features.notes: Small opaque printed cards cover under 10 percent of the two glazing bays. No portal signs.

features.name: Open door pushbar and security conduit
features.support: Existing north door leaf and solid north-east jamb
features.notes: Pushbar hugs the pre-existing leaf at x=110.06..110.105; new geometry ends at x=110.130. The central doorway stays clear.

features.name: Front rainwater pipe and flush pavement drains
features.support: Existing north-east brick pier and ground at y=0
features.notes: Pipe is 90 mm across and hugs the solid end pier. Grates are 5 mm above the existing paving, away from the portal.

features.name: Rear service ventilation, electrical box and access notices
features.support: Existing solid south wall, clear of the rear door
features.notes: Ventilator/box projection is at most 11 cm. All are east of x=113.60, rear opening is x=110.25..111.75.
